description: Ministry of Public Administration, Management and Law & Order - Notify the 3rd Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1842/2 of 23.12.2013
categorisation: This gazette notification contains amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, specifically detailing promotion criteria, service requirements, and performance evaluation procedures for public service officers. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it deals with public service recruitment, promotion conditions, service requirements, and administrative regulations for government employees, rather than government structural changes, personnel appointments, or other specialized categories.
